audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Graves levels 1 through 5 and called 6-onward a skill matchup, while every single why beneath it says she takes the lane back at level 2-3 and hard out-scales him after. The packet chart reads Graves then Cassiopeia for all six remaining rows.
audit.why: This is the exact conflict the mirrored Cassiopeia audit flagged and left for the user. Both layers and the packet now agree once the sides are flipped, and the prose needed no rewriting at all — it was already correct.
audit.corrected: Level 1 stays Graves (7/10). Level 2 through 2+ items all go to Cassiopeia: 4/10, 3/10, 3/10, 3/10, 3/10, 2/10.
sources: brief currentText content whys[1] through whys[6]

audit.whatIsWrong: Every stage was generic Graves boilerplate with no Cassiopeia cooldown in it, and one line offers a 'fifteen-second invitation' that matches nothing.
audit.why: Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s — that is the real punish window and it is long. Petrifying Gaze is 120/100/80s. Twin Fang is 0.75s at 40 mana, which is why her damage never stops.
audit.corrected: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 — a genuine 24-second gap where Quickdraw works. Petrifying Gaze is 120s at rank 1. Twin Fang re-fires every 0.75s, so there is no reload window on her side to wait out.
sources: _kits/cassiopeia.json W cd 24/22/20/18/16, R cd 120/100/80, E cd 0.75

audit.whatIsWrong: The mid text says Smoke Screen 'only stops auto-attacks' and is therefore dead weight. Graves' E is called 'Bushwhack'. Her passive is called a 'no-boots passive' twice.
audit.why: Smoke Screen reduces sight range and briefly slows — it never stopped auto-attacks, so the stated reason it is useless is itself wrong (it does still deny her vision and slow her). Graves' E is Quickdraw. Riot's text for Serpentine Grace says only that move-speed bonuses are more effective on her; there is no boots restriction in the description.
audit.corrected: Smoke Screen cuts her sight and slows her on impact — that is a real disengage against a champion who has to see you to click Twin Fang, just not a damage answer. Quickdraw's True Grit stacks armor and MR. Serpentine Grace amplifies every move-speed bonus she buys.

audit.why: Miasma is correctly identified as the one cooldown that decides whether you can step forward; it just needed its 24s attached.

edits.before: This is her lane now, not yours. Your W (Smoke Screen) blind is useless here — it only stops auto-attacks, and Cass is pure ability damage — so your one anti-carry tool is dead weight. At 6 her Petrifying Gaze stuns you the instant you E in facing her for the burst, and her poison keeps ticking through the lock while you're frozen. Your realistic plan is to bait that R out or all-in only when your jungler is there and she's grounded you into a wall; in a raw 1v1 you cannot push through Miasma plus the stun.
edits.after: This is her lane now, not yours. Smoke Screen never blinded anything — it cuts her sight and slows on impact, so use it to break the trade, not to stop damage she deals with abilities. At 6 Petrifying Gaze (120s at rank 1) stuns you the instant you dash in facing her, and Twin Fang keeps ticking every 0.75s while you're frozen. Bait that R, or all-in only with your jungler and only in Miasma's 24-second gap; in a raw 1v1 you cannot push through the grounding plus the stun.

edits.before: You are flatly out-scaled. With Liandry's and Rylai's, Cass's percent-HP poison burns straight through your stacked armor and her perma-slow ignores everything True Grit gives you — and her no-boots passive lets her kite the windows where your 2-shell magazine is empty and reloading. Your damage runs dry before she's even low. Don't side-lane into her in the open; group, use your E mobility to flank onto her squishy body, and lean on the leads you forced in the early skirmishes.
edits.after: You are flatly out-scaled. With Liandry's and Rylai's her poison burns straight through stacked armor and the perma-slow ignores everything True Grit gives you — and Serpentine Grace makes every move-speed bonus she owns hit harder, so she kites the windows where your 2-shell magazine is empty. Your damage runs dry before she's low. Don't side-lane her in the open; group, use Quickdraw to flank onto her squishy body, and lean on leads you forced in the early skirmishes.

notes: The level chart was the whole story here: six of seven rows contradicted the prose sitting directly under them, and the mirrored Cassiopeia audit had already flagged the conflict without resolving it. Flipped as one atomic group across both layers; the packet chart agrees exactly. Also fixed: 'Bushwhack' (Graves' E is Quickdraw), the 'no-boots passive' claim (Riot's Serpentine Grace text says only that move-speed bonuses are more effective on her — no boots restriction appears anywhere in the description), and the mid-text claim that Smoke Screen 'only stops auto-attacks'. Packet suspectName 'Land Petrifying Gaze' is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is the correct name. Packet has only 15 Emerald+ games, so nothing here rests on the 46.67% figure.
